name: Harami Tama
source: The protagonist is an ordinary high school student until one day, he has a strange dream after which he is led into the youkai world to discover that he is Ou no Mitama who possesses soul of a king, and if he makes a child with one of the princesses of youkai tribe, that child will be a king of youkai.
translation: The protagonist is an ordinary high school student until one day, he has a strange dream after which he is led into the youkai world to discover that he is Ou no Mitama who possesses soul of a king, and if he makes a child with one of the princesses of youkai tribe, that child will be a king of youkai.
